overview: This paper proposes DESIGNER, a design-logic-guided data synthesis pipeline that extracts reusable Design Logics from existing questions and matches them with raw corpora to generate large-scale, multidisciplinary reasoning data for LLM fine-tuning and evaluation.

modules.name: Corpus Preprocessing & Filtering
modules.description: Processes raw book and web corpora by splitting long texts, applying MinHash deduplication, and filtering based on readability, educational value, and reasoning potential scores.

modules.name: Multidimensional Data Labeling & Scoring
modules.description: Assigns multidimensional metadata to raw corpora and the question bank, including disciplinary classification, difficulty levels, question types, and reasoning-oriented scores using LLMs and fine-tuned classifiers.

modules.name: Question Bank Clustering & Sampling
modules.description: Constructs a diverse and high-quality question subset by computing embeddings, performing K-means clustering with silhouette search, and sampling across clusters based on predefined difficulty ratios.

modules.name: Design Logic Extraction
modules.description: Reverse-engineers sampled questions to extract underlying design principles, prompting a reasoning LLM to abstract the human expert's thought process into structured, Mermaid-formatted Design Logics.

modules.name: Design Logic Deduplication
modules.description: Removes redundant Design Logics by embedding them into a vector space, constructing a similarity graph based on a threshold, identifying connected components, and retaining the centroid logic of each group.

modules.name: Two-Stage Logic Retrieval
modules.description: Matches source text segments with the Design Logic library using a coarse-to-fine approach: vector similarity retrieves top candidate logics, followed by an LLM-based fine-grained selection of the most suitable logic.

modules.name: Question Synthesis & Generation
modules.description: Generates graduate-level, self-contained reasoning questions and reference answers by instructing an LLM to strictly follow the retrieved Design Logic steps while grounding the content in the source text.

modules.name: Response Synthesis & Data Decontamination
modules.description: Generates long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) responses for the synthesized questions using a reasoning model, and applies MinHash deduplication and n-gram decontamination against evaluation benchmarks to prevent data leakage.

modules.name: Data Analysis & Diversity Evaluation
modules.description: Quantitatively assesses the synthesized datasets by computing difficulty distributions, disciplinary coverage, and five semantic diversity metrics (Mean Cosine/L2 Distance, 1-NN Distance, Cluster Inertia, Radius) against baseline datasets.

modules.name: Supervised Fine-Tuning Pipeline
modules.description: Manages the training workflow for fine-tuning base LLMs on the synthesized datasets, handling epoch scheduling, batch processing, optimization, and loss computation.

modules.name: Multi-Benchmark Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluates fine-tuned models using zero-shot prompting across multiple multidisciplinary benchmarks, computing single-run accuracy and Self-Consistency with Chain-of-Thought (CoT-SC) across multiple rollouts.

modules.name: Ablation & Comparative Experiment
modules.description: Executes controlled experiments by replacing or removing key components (Design Logic, coarse ranking, fine ranking) and comparing against baseline synthetic datasets to validate the contribution of each pipeline stage.
